text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: —Kyaaah. Those chocolates are super cute!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that insane? So shiny and super 
ritzy! I want that one~

text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
You sure love fancy-looking stuff like 
that~ Then why not give Trainer that 
thing?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that sounds nice too. I think I'll 
have some to match you! ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
You bought one for yourself too, huh? 
Honestly, that's kinda surprising.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos talks about her Trainer a ton, so 
she must super love them, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I love it! ♡ That's why I'm giving 
you some for Valentine's!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
...Well, shameless as always. Whatever, so 
I just thought, "I'll just buy it, then."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"True! You wanna give something handmade 
to your special someone, right? I make 
cakes for my partner too~."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? When did you do that!? Hey, spill 
the details!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, hey. Do you think people are 
happy to get handmade things?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You know me, right? I'm totally into 
high-end brands, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So, I kinda thought a proper one would 
make them happier, you know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend A
Vivlos's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Though honestly, I can't say for sure what 
Trainer thinks about it...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
"We're basically just students, so maybe 
they'd feel it's too much and won't accept 
it."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, like, if they still accept it... 
doesn't that mean there's a huge chance!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: There's a chance...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, do I actually *want* Trainy to 
be interested in me!?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend A
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What's this all of a sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that make it sound like... you 
think of Trainer-chi in *that* way?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I don't really know, but... is it 
not?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ......I don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wha, what, what!? I don't get it, 
this is bad~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You're just like my big sisters, 
Trainie... You're so gentle, and you spoil 
me so much...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...That's why, I lo—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...That's troublesome...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after finishing Vivlos's training 
and working in the Trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos came in surprisingly quietly. 
Something about the atmosphere felt 
nostalgic... Right, just like before we 
signed our contract...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking she had been misunderstood, 
Vivlos had mustered her courage to come 
and talk about her true feelings for her 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Tell me anything, I'll take it all in.
Tell me anything, I'm here for you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...I-It's not that big a deal!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Here! I just wanted to give you this!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right! I bought it at the 
department store basement food hall!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
This chocolate brand is super popular in 
Dubai too, apparently~, and they just 
happened to have a pop-up shop here♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'll be looking forward to my White Day 
gift♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~, I was so nervous.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Because everyone's saying weird things! 
Trainy is just Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...To accept it, huh.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I should've made it by hand?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Will you take it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sensing Vivlos's serious atmosphere, I 
braced myself. Of course, as her 
Trainer... I'm confident I can take on all 
of her feelings.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Then—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Will you accept this?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I made it. It's my homemade chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words suddenly hit me. Today was 
Valentine's Day. And what she just said 
earlier...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, w-wait! Just... wait a second."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
“......Um, you know. I want you to have 
this.”

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I don't get it either. I don't, but...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I care about you, Trainer, just as much as 
my big sisters...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Because my love for it is absolute.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So, it's fine, right? It won't cause any 
trouble, will it...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Trainie! ...Thank you, as always.
